description: Defines the Ext.ux.grid.filter.DateFilter class for filtering grid data by date, including configuration options, event handling, and validation methods.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.filter.DateFilter
classes.description: A date filter class for Ext JS grid filters, allowing filtering by date with configurable options and validation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, sets up menu items and event listeners.

methods.name: onCheckChange
methods.description: Handles check change events for filter options.

methods.name: onInputKeyUp
methods.description: Handles keyup events on input fields within the menu.

methods.name: onMenuSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a date from the date menu, updating filter state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current filter values as an object.

methods.name: isActivatable
methods.description: Determines if the filter can be activated based on current state.

methods.name: getSerialArgs
methods.description: Serializes the filter data for server transmission.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of a specific date field.

methods.name: getPicker
methods.description: Returns the date picker component for a specific field.

methods.name: validateRecord
methods.description: Validates a data record against the filter criteria.
